protocol.perKitRule: measuredPerKit (accepted from start to kit completion) <= perKitTolerance x perKit. Where (perKitTolerance - 1) x perKit is smaller than the entrance's own static storage (staticStorage on the port: for a belt its dead-end entrance belt, 8 items per tile, plus its ring limit; for a fluid every pipe of that fluid plus one input fluid box of each machine using it) the rule is applied to consumedPerKit (accepted minus what still sits on belts, the ring, machine inputs, arm hands, pipes and fluid boxes at kit completion). With the current layout this applies to stone-brick, lubricant and sulfuric-acid.

builds.feedPolicy: Declared west entrances only, throttled to their declared per-minute supply (belt credit capped at 8, one item at a time on alternating lanes; fluids per tick with a one-second carry); items removed only from declared east chests in the selective-refill step; no inventories seeded
